title: The Last-Minute Legally Blonde Costume
intro: You do not need a new outfit. You need four things that make it obvious from across the room. A hot pink oversized knit over the jeans you already own, a fluffy pom pom pen, a jumbo velvet scrunchie and a tiny plush chihuahua riding in a pink carrier. Nobody needs it explained, and you will not spend the party adjusting a costume. Order it the week of the party, wear it once with total commitment, then keep the sweater on rotation until spring. The carrier makes a very good handbag for anyone brave enough.
